glosses: a third (one of three equal parts)
a third-party (an outsider of a group)

examples.text: Un tiers des prisonniers s'est échappé.
examples.en: A third of the prisoners have escaped.

examples.text: Un tiers des six membres était des femmes.
examples.en: One-third of the six members were women.

examples.text: Un tiers est inférieur à un demi.
examples.en: A third is less than a half.

examples.text: Nous passons un tiers de nos vies à dormir.
examples.en: We spend a third of our lives sleeping.

examples.text: Elle passe plus du tiers de son temps à s'occuper de papiers.
examples.en: She spends over a third of her time doing paperwork.
